ItemID: 1; Title: Ginsco 580 pcs 2:1 Heat Shrink Tubing Kit 6 Colors 11 Sizes Assorted Sleeving Tube Wrap Cable Wire Kit for DIY; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Useful alongside my wire connectors, but I would choose the adhesive-lined kit instead this time.
ItemID: 2; Title: XHF 1-1/4 Inch (30mm) 3:1 Waterproof Heat Shrink Tubing Marine Grade Wire Cable Adhesive Lined Tube Insulation Seal Against Moisture Corrosion and Air Leakage, 4 Ft Red; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no clear need for tubing in this specific large diameter.
ItemID: 3; Title: WAGO 2 Port (10) 3 Port (10) 5 Port (5) 221 Splicing Connector, Lever-Nut Assortment Pocket Pack for All Wire 12-24 AWG; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: These look useful for joining wires during repairs, complementing my existing spade connectors.
ItemID: 4; Title: Digital Caliper, 0-6" Electronic Caliper Auto - Off Feature with Large LCD Screen Vernier Caliper Conversion Measuring Tool for Length Depth Inner Outer Diameter Measuring; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Measuring pipe and fitting diameters could help, but I would wait until a repair needs that precision.
ItemID: 5; Title: Loctite 908570 2.7 oz Tub Clear Silicone Waterproof Sealant, Single Tube; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Waterproof sealing fits my repair interests, but I have no specific sealing job in mind right now.
ItemID: 6; Title: Gorilla Waterproof Patch & Seal Tape 4" x 10' White, (Pack of 1); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I have bought Gorilla tape before, and this looks useful for broader waterproof patches, though white limits where I would use it.
ItemID: 7; Title: Nilight - 50031R 240 Pcs/120 Pairs Splice Wire Terminals T-Tap Self-Stripping with Nylon Fully Insulated Male Quick Disconnects Kit; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Electrical connectors fit my interests, but I already have an assortment and do not currently need wire taps.

ItemID: 9; Title: CRC 05103 QD Electronic Cleaner -11 Wt Oz; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My history includes electrical repair supplies, but I have no current need to clean electronic contacts.
